blocks.title: how to build your own *AI setter* with Make and ChatGPT

blocks.text: add an External Request to your Default Reply. it sends each lead message to a Make webhook.
a Custom webhook catches the message. a ChatGPT "Generate a response" module writes the reply with your instructions.
Webhook Response sends the reply to Manychat, which saves it in a field and posts it in the DM.
save each lead's Conversation ID in a custom field and send it back with every message. it doesn't wire itself.

blocks.heading: then the lead sends *three* messages in a row

list: one fit question at a time.

blocks.text: Make credits on every run, OpenAI tokens on every reply, and your weekends, debugging it.
the model isn't the setter. ManySetter already waits, remembers, qualifies, books, follows up and hands you the chat, inside your Manychat.

cta.line: and i'll show you how to set up your AI setter for free.
